redesign.research: Notion (sidebar page tree, 'Move to…' command with a page search, trash with restore, new page = an empty editor that exists on first edit), Linear docs. Phones: the tree opens as a full sheet.
redesign.job: Find a page (tree, search, recently changed) or start a new one.
redesign.phone: Toolbar: search + 'Seiten' button (tree in a sheet). Recently changed rows; EmptyState 'Erste Seite anlegen' for a fresh wiki. Round + Neue Seite. ⋯ Papierkorb.
moves: trash text link + ?status=trash → ⋯ menu item, ?trash=1 (old param redirects)
hand-made lists → kept as rows (title + snippet + date)
empty wiki → EmptyState with Neue Seite

sweep.note: Checked: opens the last/first page, tree as sheet on phones.

pages.title: Wissen (Papierkorb view: list heading 'Papierkorb')
pages.purpose: Browse the page tree, search titles and texts, see recently changed pages, open the trash.

urlState.meaning: search title + body (ilike), up to 50 results

sections.title: Seiten (tree)
sections.notes: <TreeNav> in a left aside (16rem, sticky on lg; above the list on phones). Visibility icons (lock/member card/globe). Not draggable here. Empty 'Noch keine Seiten.'

sections.title: Toolbar
sections.notes: Text link 'Papierkorb' / 'Zurück zu den Seiten' next to the search (wiki.manage).

sections.title: Zuletzt geändert / Treffer / Papierkorb
sections.notes: Hand-made list of 15 (50 with q) pages; trash rows have 'Wiederherstellen'. Empty texts: wiki.noMatch / wiki.trashEmpty / wiki.empty.

pages.empty: Noch keine Seiten. (wiki.empty) – plain text, no <EmptyState>
pages.phone: Tree aside stacks above the list (all pages expanded); round + creates a page.
uxNotes: Trash is a text link in the toolbar, not a ⋯ menu item as app.md specifies; param is status=trash while contacts uses trash=1 (URL-param drift).
Lists are hand-made <ul>s, not <DataTable>; no pagination for 'recent' (fixed 15).
Tree loads up to 2000 pages on every page view.

redesign.job: Start a page without creating anything until it's saved.
redesign.phone: Form: title (+ parent hint) and SaveBar 'Seite anlegen'; the page is created on submit and opens in the editor.
moves: create on GET (spinner) → form POST newPageAction (title, parent_id)

pages.title: Seite wird angelegt …
pages.purpose: Creates an untitled page (optionally under ?parent=) on mount and redirects to it.
uxNotes: A GET that creates data: reloading, back-button or prefetch-like revisits create extra 'Neue Seite' pages.
Empty pages are never cleaned up if the user leaves without typing.

redesign.job: Read or edit one page; move it; share it.
redesign.phone: PageHeader with crumbs (back = parent page). Header actions: Teilen; ⋯ Unterseite, Verschieben nach…, Verlauf, In den Papierkorb (asks). Tree as a sheet from 'Seiten'.
redesign.desktop: Tree left (drag & drop stays), page right; same header.
moves: hand-built header row → PageHeader (crumbs, actions, menu)
new: ⋯ Verschieben nach… → sheet ?edit=move with a page picker (top level or under a page) → movePageAction

sweep.note: The title textarea was forced to 16 px on phones by the global iOS zoom rule (looked like body text next to a big icon): fields can opt out with data-keep-size; title 3xl on phones, 4xl from md. The editor's keyboard hint ('/', ⌘S) is desktop only now.

pages.title: <Page title>

urlState.meaning: version id inside the history sheet
remount key after restoring a version

sections.notes: Left aside, lg only (hidden on phones). Drag & drop for wiki.manage: on a page = inside, upper edge = before, drop zone 'Hier ablegen = oberste Ebene'.

fields.name: body

actions.label: Teilen

overlays.title: Verlauf

actions.label: Diese Version wiederherstellen

pages.phone: Tree hidden (lg only) – navigation only through crumbs and sub-page tiles; no way to reach sibling pages except going back to /wiki.
uxNotes: No <PageHeader>: the header row is hand-built; 'Unterseite' and 'Teilen' are next to ⋯ inside the page, not portalled to the top bar like other record pages.
Visibility uses a popover with a form + Save button (app.md allows popovers for 'share settings'), but radio inputs are native, not <Choice>.
Link insertion uses window.prompt (listed as a known exception in app.md).
Drag & drop in the tree is the only way to move pages; no touch alternative and the tree is hidden on phones.
Two creation paths: /wiki/new link (GET creates) and the 'Unterseite' form post.
